pages.title: Release Qi
pages.text: At Golden Core or higher, enter combat mode and press Blast Qi (default G) to release your aura; press again to withdraw it. The eruption gathers around your body in your method's color. Flames bend with movement, carry momentum through turns, and settle after stopping while remaining close to the body.

pages.title: Release Qi
pages.text: While blasting, gain 20% movement speed and Jump Boost I-strength jumps, without potion particles. Withdrawing removes these bonuses.

pages.title: Temper the Release
pages.text: While blasting, hold Shift and scroll to change intensity by 10%, from 100% to 200%. Higher release costs more resources; 200% opens a moving domain with a 20-block radius. Exhaustion, leaving combat, or an insufficient realm ends release.

pages.title: Force Beyond the Fist
pages.text: During release, bare hands and fist weapons gain force from remaining Qi. A successful hit splashes 35% of its actual damage to up to eight eligible enemies within two blocks of the target. Walls and allies are protected. Ordinary sword and saber hits do not receive this fist splash.

pages.title: Domains and Rivals
pages.text: Domain effects require 500 active-method proficiency. NPC method proficiency varies: 50% start at 0–99, 35% at 100–499, 12% at 500–999, 2.5% at 1000–1999, and 0.5% at 2000–10000. Only Golden Core or stronger NPCs with at least 500 active-method proficiency open a domain; others use ordinary body Qi release. Rolls persist through saves, and training can raise proficiency.

pages.title: Domains and Rivals
pages.text: NPCs wait five seconds after entering combat before considering Blast Qi. They protect at least 40% maximum Qi, or the cost of their most expensive affordable learned spell, whichever is greater. Only surplus Qi may fund up to ten seconds of release. If spellcasting reaches the reserve, release stops before further upkeep. Losing the target ends it too. Recovery lasts ten seconds; training dummy controls remain manual.

pages.title: Breath and Heart
pages.text: Basic Breathing forms soft cyan currents and compressed-air rings. Clear Heart forms pale mint flames, suspended light droplets and clean impact ripples. Both domains are visual only, with no special damage, debuffs or cleansing.

pages.title: Blood Lily and Gale
pages.text: All three Blood Demon tiers grow red spider lilies over the actual animated target. Base growth uses maximum HP, like Cold Cry Ice-Seizing: max(5, 2√maxHP) seconds. Each landed hit adds 0.1 to that caster's growth multiplier on this target: 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, etc. Only full coverage drains HP and Qi each second into the caster.

pages.title: Blood Lily and Gale
pages.text: Partial flowers fade slowly outside and resume on return. Own shoulder thorns are hidden in first person. Void Breaking retains its original mint-white colors. Idle currents and red ground haze are absent; confirmed cuts flash across the target, raising dust and upward pressure. Domain cutting damage is halved.

pages.title: Rebirth and Devouring
pages.text: Reincarnation's smooth single flame carries opposing violet and pale-jade currents, including its fists and weapons. Hits echo as three staggered ghost rings. Open black-and-white wheels drift through its domain. Each eligible enemy independently rolls 1% each second for one added level of Slowness and Weakness lasting ten seconds.

pages.title: Rebirth and Devouring
pages.text: Heaven Devouring adds one percentage point per target each second: 1%, 2%, 3%, up to 100%. A warp deals HP damage based on 10% of the caster's maximum Qi, resets that target to zero, then starts again at 1% next second. Leaving or ending the domain clears accumulated chance.

pages.title: Heavenly Thunder Resonance
pages.text: Violet flames carry turquoise branches beneath slowly turning thundercloud currents. Enemies within six blocks of one another exchange automatic arcs each second. After three seconds of exposure, charged enemies periodically release extra branches; isolated enemies can draw a cloud discharge. No attack is required.

pages.title: Heavenly Thunder Resonance
pages.text: Each caster can deal domain lightning damage to a victim at most once per second.

pages.title: Ten Thousand Mountains' Weight
pages.text: Profound Mountain Edge-Shattering forms heavy earth-gold strata and floating stone. Enemies throughout the domain are slowed and gently pressed downward. Movement stirs dust and golden cracks; mountain shadows gather above them. Close groups intensify the pressure visuals without destroying terrain.

pages.title: Eternal Abyssal Current
pages.text: Cold-Tide fills its domain with deep-blue spiritual water. Each block actually travelled inside adds one Damp stack, capped at eight. Back-and-forth travel counts; standing still and teleports do not. Damp lasts ten seconds and continued movement refreshes it. Higher stacks show denser water currents. Steps leave world-anchored ripples that expand and fade.

pages.title: Eternal Abyssal Current
pages.text: Existing Damp interactions with water and ice spells remain. The caster still heals 0.2% of maximum HP each second, capped at four, and extinguishes fire.

pages.title: Ice Remembers
pages.text: Cold Cry Ice-Seizing grows ice more slowly over targets with higher maximum HP; wounds do not change the rate. Full buildup takes twice the square root of maximum HP in seconds, at least five seconds: 100 max HP takes 20 seconds. Outside the domain, partial ice melts over at least a minute per full coat and four times more slowly than buildup.

pages.title: Ice Remembers
pages.text: Re-entry resumes from the remainder. Reloading preserves it.

pages.title: Five Minutes in Ice
pages.text: Targets fully frozen by Cold Cry Ice-Seizing cannot move, attack, cast spells or use beast abilities. The domain maintains the lock; after its last contact, full freezing lasts five minutes even if the caster stops. Then the ice shatters and actions resume. Slimes and magma cubes are immune to this domain's frost, slow and full freeze.

pages.title: Ashes into Life
pages.text: Orange-red spiritual fire rises beneath enemies and breaks into gold embers that return to the caster's chest. Flame contact burns each second and restores health equal to 5% of actual HP damage dealt. Blocked damage yields no free vitality. These flames do not ignite terrain.

pages.title: Silent Winter
pages.text: Pale blue crystalline flames spread frost from feet through legs, torso, arms and head, following each mob's actual animated model. Thin transparent frost grows at the same maximum-HP base rate as red lilies: max(5, twice the square root of target maximum HP) seconds to full coverage. A 100-max-HP target takes 20 seconds; 400 takes 40 seconds. Wounds do not change this rate.

pages.title: Silent Winter
pages.text: Slowness builds from I to IV as coverage increases. Full coverage locks movement, attacks, spells and beast abilities for five minutes after the last domain contact. Partial ice slowly thaws outside and resumes from the remainder on reentry. Slimes and magma cubes are immune. Each second the caster heals 0.2% of maximum HP, capped at four, and extinguishes fire.

pages.title: Silent Winter
pages.text: When freezing ends, the coating cracks and shatters into fragments sampled from the real model surface. It is never a separate ice cube.

pages.title: Bone Bell
pages.text: Bone Bell compares innate attack plus trained physical attack plus one point for every twenty maximum HP. Bone-tempering health gains count; wounds and weapon attack modifiers do not. Strictly weaker bodies suffer thirty percent movement suppression, separate from ordinary Slowness and its cleanses. Equal or stronger bodies are unaffected.

pages.title: Bone Bell
pages.text: Ivory waves, foot dust and deep bell vibrations express physical presence without gravity. Your own rings are hidden in first-person and remain visible in third-person.

pages.title: Nether Procession
pages.text: Nine Nether Corpse-Refining wears violet-black flame and ghost-green wisps; hits leave smoky decaying marks. Nether Procession has no additional passive domain damage, Wither, Weakness, suppression or healing.

pages.title: Solar Furnace
pages.text: Solar motes erupt into golden-white pillars each second. Base damage is caster maximum HP × current Sun Energy percentage value ÷ 1000: 10%, 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% Sun Energy deal 1%, 2.5%, 5%, 7.5% and 10% of the caster's maximum HP per pillar. Current HP and target HP do not set this damage. Zero Sun Energy deals no pillar damage. Suppression and existing defenses apply.

pages.title: Solar Furnace
pages.text: Brightness, density and heat shimmer rise with current Sun Energy.

pages.title: Blood Returning to Its Source
pages.text: Flowers follow feet, limbs, torso and head, not a bounding box. At full coverage, each second drains ordinary domain HP damage and twice that amount of real Qi. Actual HP lost and Qi removed return to the caster, capped by its maxima. Partial coverage, leaving range or stopping the domain prevents drain.

pages.title: Blood Returning to Its Source
pages.text: Hit counts are saved separately per caster and target, resetting when flowers fully wilt. Misses, fully blocked hits and passive lily drain add no stacks. Overlapping domains use the strongest growth multiplier, without stacking base growth or drain pulses.

pages.title: Shadows Between Lives
pages.text: On a Reincarnation proc, an open black-and-white wheel with paired inner curves briefly appears beneath opposing body currents. Two translucent copies of the enemy's actual model separate to either side and trail its movement. Orbiting particles collapse when ten seconds end.

pages.title: Shadows Between Lives
pages.text: Another proc adds a level and refreshes ten seconds; an older, longer lower-level effect can resume afterward.

pages.title: Wind Along the Rift
pages.text: Void Breaking retains its original mint-white palette. Idle currents, floating wind fragments and red ground haze are absent. Wind paths change every 1.6 seconds; confirmed hits alone show brief crossing cuts, scene refraction, dust and upward pressure. Domain cutting damage is halved for both players and NPCs. No terrain edits are created.

pages.title: Wind Along the Rift
pages.text: Devouring instead folds the victim's silhouette inward, contracts to a black point and bursts into dark fragments.

pages.title: Wood in Bloom and Decay
pages.text: Evergreen's green-gold pollen drifts irregularly. Contact raises real collidable oak-log spikes with leaves, bark and green veins. Over two seconds the wood cracks and withers, dissolving in stages during the final half-second. Further contacts may erupt again. Existing terrain and later player edits are preserved.

pages.title: When Domains Collide
pages.text: At 200% release, a bright membrane marks your moving twenty-block domain. Hostile fields compress against one another; both membranes shudder and rebound as sparks, opposing streams and pressure waves erupt along their contact seam. Domain effects remain within the compressed boundary. After four seconds, the active method with the higher cultivation ceiling wins.

pages.title: When Domains Collide
pages.text: Equal ceilings compare method proficiency; exact ties remain locked until separation or a changed advantage. The losing domain shatters while body Qi remains. Reopening requires three seconds of recovery. Players and NPCs follow the same rules.
